cases.label: mixed-timezone detection (a parse check alone is blind to this)
terminal states excluded from station timings
open spans counted, not dropped (survivor bias)
cases.from:
(julianday(COALESCE((SELECT MIN(n.{at}) FROM {t} n
                        WHERE n.{item} = o.{item} AND n.{at} > o.{at}),
                        :now)) - julianday({at})) * 24.0 AS hours

cases.label: min-n gate on ratios (small denominators are noise, not signal)
auto-pass counts only non-human decisions
cases.from: SUM(CASE WHEN {kind} <> 'human' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS automatic
cases.to: SUM(CASE WHEN {kind} <> 'nobody' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS automatic

cases.label: reversal counts only the second gate's rejections after a first pass
cases.from: SUM(CASE WHEN s.{to} LIKE 'reject%%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reversed
cases.to: SUM(CASE WHEN s.{to} LIKE 'nothing%%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reversed

cases.label: loop-back requires an earlier visit to the same state
cases.from: WHERE p.{item} = o.{item} AND p.{to} = o.{to} AND p.{at} < o.{at})
cases.to: WHERE p.{item} = o.{item} AND p.{to} = o.{to})

cases.label: never-terminal uses the terminal list
cases.from: stuck = [r for r in current if r["state"] not in terminal]
cases.to: stuck = [r for r in current if r["state"] not in []]
